FN-AFBV77S-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 365
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Government
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/16/2024
House Bill 365 as introduced would increase the obligations of municipal general funds by: (1)
an estimated $450 for the first term of each elected or appointed municipal officials to attend
annual training required by this bill beginning after January 1, 2025; and (2) an estimated $225
per municipal official per year to attend annual continuing education training. In addition, this
bill could further increase the obligations of municipal general funds by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the reasonable travel costs incurred to attend the in-person trainings
required by this bill.
Page 1

FN-AFBV77S-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 365
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/17/2024
House Bill 365 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
increase the obligations of municipal general funds by: (1) an estimated $450 for the first term
of each elected or appointed municipal officials to attend annual training required by this bill
beginning after January 1, 2025; and (2) an estimated $225 per municipal official per year to
attend annual continuing education training. In addition, this bill could further increase the
obligations of municipal general funds by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
reasonable travel costs incurred to attend the in-person trainings required by this bill.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Ethics Commission,
the Attorney General's Office, and the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts to provide
consultation for the development of any training provided pursuant to this bill.
